text:
maria: FYI I'm kicking off a small thread — we're seeing nontrivial p99 deltas when serving q4f16 variants across AZs in EU. want to lock down Dedicated pool sizing + autoscale headroom before we finalize the Q3 commit. anyone seen this pattern before?
ajay: saw something similar on a70 tests — cross-AZ adds +10–20ms p50 and bigger p99 tail when KV cache misses line up. could be network + kernel latency.
ben: kernel note: fused attention + nvfuser path on H100 had ~5–8ms better p50 vs baseline but p99 improved only if batch concurrency stayed <= 8. q4f16 quant increases compute variance.
sophie: ran a micro-sim this morning — pasted numbers: H100(q4f16) p50=11ms p95=42ms p99=110ms @ conc=16; A100(q4f16) p50=16ms p95=60ms p99=180ms @ conc=12. cross-AZ adds ~25–40ms p99 depending on AZ pair.
maria: ok that's bigger than I expected. for Dedicated sizing we usually target 99th <= 120ms for chat. with those A100 numbers we either increase headroom or force regional routing to avoid cross-AZ for latency-sensitive customers. thoughts? :thinking_face:
ajay: two levers — increase GPU count (reduce concurrency per GPU) or tune autoscaler to keep spare replicas (headroom). i'd rather keep region affinity for production and allow cross-AZ for low-priority workloads.
ops-oncall: +1 on spare replicas but watch cooldowns — autoscale cooldown of 5m can make you miss bursts. recommend buffer_pct 30% and shorter cooldowns for traffic spikes.
ben: sample config I propose for Dedicated EU chat pools:
```
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 30
  desired_concurrency_per_gpu: 10
  scale_buffer_pct: 35
  cooldown_seconds: 120
  fallback_policy: [regional-fallback, lower-precision-quant]
```
maria: that config looks reasonable. can we simulate cost delta? if we drop desired_concurrency_per_gpu from 16 to 10 for A100 in eu-west, estimate +42% GPU cost but p99 drops under 120ms per sophie's sim.
sophie: correct on sim. also noted that switching kernel from nvfuser->flash-attention stabilized p99 by ~20% for H100 in same-AZ runs. kernel choice matters more for heavier sequence lengths.
ajay: runbook note: when we enable regional affinity we should also set fallback to lower-cost quant variants in other regions, not immediate cross-AZ failover, to avoid latency spike penalties.
infra-bot: load-test scheduled: /runs/bench-2415001234 at 2026-06-05T03:00:00Z — includes H100/A100 mixes + cross-AZ traffic.
maria: action items: @ajay run cost sim for desired_concurrency=10/12 for eu-west A100 and H100 mixes; @sophie re-run with flash-attention kernel on H100 and include seq len 1024; @ben update autoscaler PR with buffer_pct=35 and cooldown=120s. I'll draft an ops rollback threshold: if p99 > 200ms for 5min -> revert to regional routing + scale up 2 replicas.
ops-oncall: please add alert: metric "dedicated.eu.chat.p99" > 180ms for 3m -> paging. prefer 3m for noise filtering. :bell: 
maria: linking dashboard for reference: https://dash.redwood.ai/capacity/eu-dedicated-chat?run=bench-2415001234
ben: quick note on measurements — tag samples with `kernel` and `quant` so we can slice p99 in the dashboard. also include `az_pair` label.
sophie: will send a small CSV of sim outputs after the kernel run.
maria: great, let's reconvene after the infra-bot run. thanks everyone :pray:
